1.title: The Fishing Hole in My Room / The Time Machine Is Lost!! / Remember! The Impression of That Day
1.description: In the 1-hour 2005 series premiere special, Doraemon opens an indoor fishing pond on Nobita's tatami mat, chases a runaway time machine, and revisits the unforgettable day they first met.

1.title: All the Way From the Future World / The Mecha-Maker
1.description: Noby's life changes forever when Doraemon, a robotic cat from the 22nd century, hops out of his desk drawer. Then Doraemon's Mecha-Maker turns Noby's spaceship drawing into a working craft.

2.title: Transformade / Battle of the Dueling Nobys!
2.description: Noby uses Doraemon's Transformade gadget to boost his athletic skills with chaotic side effects, then spawns multiple time-traveling Nobys fighting over how to spend his gift money.

3.title: Memory Bread / Lost-And-Found Fishing Pond
3.description: Doraemon helps Noby cram for tests by eating Memory Bread, then introduces a gadget pond that fishes up lost belongings.

4.title: Noby, The Great Illusionist / My Best Friend Doraemon
4.description: Noby becomes an illusionist after Sneech swindles his prized card, then Sneech misuses a friendship gadget to come between Doraemon and Noby.

5.title: The Not So Lucky, Lucky Cards! / Big G: Master Chef
5.description: Noby discovers a wish-granting deck of 52 cards with a catch on the 53rd card, while Big G's passion for cooking terrifies the neighborhood.

6.title: The Woodcutter's Pond / My Pet Rock
6.description: A futuristic pond swaps ordinary items for upgraded versions, and Doraemon gives Noby an animated pet rock when his parents refuse a dog.

7.title: Doraemon's Time Capsule
7.description: Noby borrows Doraemon's time capsule without realizing it sends its contents 100 years into the past, threatening Doraemon's own timeline.

8.title: Machine Copy Machine! / My Own Golden Cloud
8.description: A gadget that copies any machine's power falls into Big G's hands, and Noby learns the rules of riding his own golden cloud.

9.title: Vacuum Cleaner Super Car / Dad's Day Off
9.description: Doraemon transforms the family vacuum cleaner into a supercar, then Noby's tall tales land his dad in a match against sumo wrestlers.

10.title: Invasion of the Body Swappers! / Livin' the Dream
10.description: A body-part swapping gadget spirals out of control across town, and Doraemon steps in to direct Noby's dreams.

11.title: Escape from Score Zero / Go to the Doctor, Doraemon!
11.description: Noby uses the time machine to avoid another zero test score, then shrinks down to repair Doraemon from the inside when he falls ill.

12.title: The Skyhorse! / Action Quiz!
12.description: Noby befriends a flying Skyhorse from the 22nd century, followed by a high-stakes futuristic quiz challenge with Big G.

13.title: A-maze-ing House / Worst Birthday Ever
13.description: Noby turns his house into a shifting labyrinth, then teams up with Doraemon as time-traveling ninjas to save Sue's ruined birthday.

14.title: Sequence Spray / The Connection Cap
14.description: A spray brings still drawings to brief motion for Noby's art project, and the gang traces a chain of acquaintances to meet a movie star.

15.title: Black Hole, White Hole / Surfin' the Dream Channels
15.description: Noby accidentally creates a miniature black hole in his room, then channel-surfs through his friends' dreams late at night.

16.title: Doraemon, Squared / Dinosaur Alert!
16.description: A special futuristic drink turns Doraemon into a strict cube-shaped perfectionist, and real dinosaurs appear in the forest outside town.

17.title: Instant Delivery Magic! / The Genie-less Magic Lamp
17.description: Noby stages a magic show using teleportation tricks, then tests a magic lamp gadget where he has to play the genie himself.

18.title: The Evo-Devo Beam / The Action Planner
18.description: An evolution-devolution beam turns household critters into prehistoric beasts and futuristic creatures, followed by an unstoppable daily planner.

19.title: Experimental Dream Schemes
19.description: Noby tests a collection of experimental dream pillows from the 22nd century, blurring the line between waking life and dream adventures.

20.title: Noby's Turn at Bat / The House of Forced Fitness
20.description: Doraemon helps Noby step up to the plate for Big G's baseball team, while a fitness gadget transforms the house into an obstacle gym.

21.title: Werewolf Cream / Monsters in the House
21.description: A jar of Werewolf Cream causes panic whenever anyone glimpses a round object, and spooky monsters overrun the Nobi house.

22.title: King of the Cavemen / The Moodmaker Orchestra
22.description: Noby travels back to the Stone Age hoping to rule as king, then a tiny robot orchestra scores every emotion in real life.

23.title: Time Kerchief / A Good Deed in a Weary World
23.description: Doraemon's Time Kerchief ages and rewinds everyday objects, and a gadget rewards good deeds in the most inconvenient ways.

24.title: Makin' Tracks / Noby the Robot
24.description: Noby crafts lifelike dinosaur fossil tracks that fool the whole town, then pilots a giant toy robot copy of himself.

25.title: U.F.Yo! / What Day is Today?
25.description: Noby and Doraemon stage a convincing UFO sighting for Sneech, then use a calendar gadget to turn an ordinary weekday into a holiday.

26.title: A Visitor From the Future
26.description: A mysterious fugitive from the 22nd century arrives in town, putting Doraemon and Noby's bond to the ultimate test in the Season 1 finale.

27.title: Calm Down, Big G! / Hello Martians
27.description: Noby uses the Tranquilizer Stick to calm Big G's temper until Sneech steals it, then builds miniature Martians to shoot a sci-fi movie.

28.title: Attaboy, Noby! / Treasure Huntin' Pork Chop
28.description: A gadget makes everyone praise Noby's smallest mistakes, and Big G's dog Pork Chop leads the gang on an unexpected treasure hunt.

29.title: Erase Your Face / Doraemon, Doraemon, Everywhere
29.description: An eraser lets Noby redraw facial expressions at will, then time-traveling duplicates of Doraemon crowd into the room at once.

30.title: Doraemon and the Space Shooters
30.description: Noby and Doraemon blast off into deep space when a futuristic space-shooter game turns into a real interstellar rescue.

31.title: Guiding Angel / Big G's Pizza of Terror
31.description: A tiny puppet Guiding Angel gives Noby advice he soon regrets, and Big G forces his friends to taste his monstrous homemade pizza.

32.title: Invasion of the Goat Aliens
32.description: Noby and Doraemon journey to a distant planet to help peaceful alien villagers stand up to invading space bullies.

33.title: Animal Transformation Crackers / Deluxified
33.description: A box of crackers temporarily transforms guests into animals right in front of Dad's boss, and a beam upgrades cheap items into over-the-top luxury.

34.title: Feeling Crabby / Rock Your World Record
34.description: A crab gadget makes people walk sideways, and Noby tries to claim an official world record using futuristic training gear.

35.title: Noby Goes Off the Rails / The UnNoby
35.description: A train-rope gadget turns Noby into an express locomotive, and a mirror double with the exact opposite personality takes his place.

36.title: Elementary, My Dear Doraemon / Kernels of Wrath
36.description: Detective Noby investigates a neighborhood mystery with faulty clues, while a kettle pops kernels out of pent-up anger.

37.title: Attack of the Clones / Hole Away From Home
37.description: Self-multiplying clones of Noby rebel over chores, and a portable tunnel digs a secret hideout beneath town.

38.title: Bug Hero Fix / Snowkid on the Block
38.description: A superhero belt grants insect strength to Noby, and a living snowman keeps cool in the middle of summer.

39.title: Blowback Bobby / When the Last Leaf Falls
39.description: A punching-bag doll bounces blows back at bullies, followed by a touching autumn story when Noby tries to cheer up a friend.

40.title: Gorgon's Spell / Snow Melt
40.description: A mythical Gorgon gadget freezes legs to stone when overused, and a winter heat ray triggers an indoor snowmelt.

41.title: It's the End of the World As We Know It / The Horizon Line
41.description: A misunderstood prophecy sends Noby building an ark, and Horizon Tape stretches his bedroom into a boundless plain.

42.title: The Galaxy Grand-Prix
42.description: Noby and Doraemon enter an intergalactic racing tournament across treacherous alien worlds.

43.title: See You Go Round / The Puppet Master's Camera
43.description: A periscope gadget peers anywhere around town, and a special camera lets its holder puppeteer toy replicas of people.

44.title: SuperBaby Panic / A Hurricane is a Boy's Best Friend
44.description: Noby babysits an unexpectedly super-powered toddler, then raises a playful baby typhoon named Fuko.

45.title: I Saw A Ghost!
45.description: Summer ghost stories take a supernatural turn when Doraemon brings out gadgets that make spirits all too real.

46.title: G-Tastic G to the Rescue / Noby's Tough to Stomach
46.description: Big G becomes an unstoppable caped hero for a day, and Doraemon shrinks into Sue's stomach to retrieve a swallowed gemstone.

47.title: Rub-a-Dub-Dub, See the World from a Tub! / Big Boys Do Cry
47.description: Doraemon turns the bathtub into a scenic world tour, and Sneech's bottled-up tears flood the neighborhood.

48.title: What's on the Robo-Catwalk? / The Greatest Little Town in the World
48.description: A fashion camera designs wild outfits on the spot, and the kids shrink down inside a miniature model town.

49.title: Noby's Home is His Castle
49.description: Traveling to a medieval German castle to solve a ghostly mystery, Doraemon and Noby uncover a royal secret.

50.title: A Little Adventure
50.description: Shrunk to the size of thumbtacks, Noby, Sue, Big G, and Sneech brave backyard wilderness in an epic miniature expedition.

51.title: Noby! Noby! He's Our Man! / Gone with the Sneeze
51.description: Magical cheerleading gloves make Noby unbeatable at every game, and sneeze-inducing pollen launches people across the sky.

52.title: Let Cat's Cradle Rule the World / Big G's Big Show
52.description: A What-If Box turns Noby into a world-famous cat's cradle prodigy, and Big G prepares his biggest concert ever in the series finale.
